description: Pre-execution trust filter for agent tool calls. The enforcing component is @marketnow/cline-trust-plugin (Cline plugin, npm) — this artifact publishes the rule manifest and policy semantics it enforces. The manifest and the plugin are kept in sync; the endpoint makes no claims about rules that do not exist in code.

rules.matches: credential and secret files referenced as path segments: .env, .aws/credentials, .ssh/id_rsa, .npmrc, .git-credentials
rules.semantics: DENY the call, emit audit receipt

rules.matches: destructive recursive deletes: rm with -r/-f flag combinations in any letter case
rules.semantics: DENY the call, emit audit receipt
DENY the call, emit audit receipt
DENY the call, emit audit receipt

rules.matches: secret material in outbound args (private key blocks, bearer tokens, sk-/ghp_/AKIA/xox-style tokens)
rules.semantics: DENY the call, emit audit receipt

rules.matches: wrapped server ATC card_id or CA kid (UTA_TRUST_CARD_ID / UTA_TRUST_KID env), resolved against /api/ocsp
rules.semantics: DENY unless status=VALID and recommendation=PERMIT; responder unreachable = DENY (fail-closed)

decision_semantics.on_match: DENY — the tool call never reaches the wrapped server; a signed audit receipt is emitted to the Merkle audit log
decision_semantics.on_no_match: PERMIT — call proceeds to the wrapped MCP server

audit_log: Append-only Merkle tree of every decision (DENY + PERMIT) — get_audit_log in the plugin
enforcement: npm @marketnow/cline-trust-plugin — wrap(externalServer) applies the full filter to every tools/call; check_interceptor() runs it dry
integration_example: import uta from '@marketnow/cline-trust-plugin'; const wrapped = uta.wrap(server);
